canonical_name: Requests Not Forwarded to Service Providers
description: Deletion requests are not being forwarded to service providers who process consumer data on behalf of the business, or no mechanism exists to ensure service providers delete consumer data. CCPA requires businesses to direct service providers to delete consumer data from their records when the business receives a deletion request.
applicability: Multi-vendor data processing environments Cloud service provider integrations Third-party analytics platforms Marketing automation service providers Customer data platform (CDP) ecosystems SaaS application integrations

metadata.detection_notes: Review CCPA compliance documentation and controls for RIGHTS requirements.
